title: Decoding Critical Targets and Signaling Pathways in EBV-Mediated Diseases Using Large Language Models.
authors: Yu, Jingwen; Wang, Yaohao; Wang, Haidong; Wei, Zhi; Pei, Yonggang
one_liner_zh: 用大语言模型筛选EBV相关文献并分析宿主信号通路与蛋白互作，虽涉及EBV转录因子但无蛋白质-DNA结合建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题关联弱。
abstract: Epstein-Barr virus (EBV), a member of the gamma herpesvirus, is the first identified human oncovirus and is associated with various malignancies. Understanding the intricate interactions between EBV antigens and cellular pathways is crucial to unraveling the molecular mechanisms in EBV-mediated diseases. However, fully elucidating EBV-host interactions and the associated pathogenesis remains a significant challenge. In this study, we employed large language models (LLMs) to screen 36,105 EBV-relevant scientific publications and summarize the current literature landscape on various EBV-associated diseases like Burkitt lymphoma (BL), diffuse large B-cell lymphoma (DLBCL), nasopharyngeal carcinoma (NPC), and so on. LLM-generated data indicate that the most-studied EBV-associated pathways are enriched in immune response, apoptosis, cell growth, and replication. The analyses of protein-protein interactions (PPIs) reveal three principal EBV-related protein clusters: TP53-centered apoptotic factors, EBV-associated transcription factors, and immune response elements. Utilizing our dataset and public databases, we demonstrated that BLLF3-targeted TLR2-associated factors are effective diagnostic markers for DLBCL. Next, we confirmed the co-expression of LMP1-targeted calcium pathway factors in BL. Finally, we demonstrated the correlation and co-expression of LMP1-induced PARP1, HIF1A, HK2, and key glycolysis-related factors, further suggesting that LMP1 actively regulates the glycolysis pathway. Therefore, our study presents a comprehensive functional encyclopedia of the interactions between EBV antigens and host signaling pathways across various EBV-associated diseases, providing valuable insights for the development of therapeutic strategies.
abstract_zh: EB病毒（Epstein-Barr virus, EBV）作为γ疱疹病毒家族成员，是首个被发现的人类肿瘤病毒，与多种恶性肿瘤相关。理解EBV抗原与细胞通路之间的复杂相互作用，对于揭示EBV介导疾病的分子机制至关重要。然而，全面阐明EBV-宿主相互作用及其相关发病机制仍是一项重大挑战。在本研究中，我们利用大语言模型（large language models, LLMs）筛选了36,105篇EBV相关科学文献，并总结了当前关于多种EBV相关疾病（如伯基特淋巴瘤（Burkitt lymphoma, BL）、弥漫大B细胞淋巴瘤（diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, DLBCL）、鼻咽癌（nasopharyngeal carcinoma, NPC）等）的文献概况。LLM生成的数据表明，研究最多的EBV相关通路富集于免疫应答、细胞凋亡、细胞生长和复制。蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用（protein-protein interactions, PPIs）分析揭示了三个主要的EBV相关蛋白簇：以TP53为中心的凋亡因子、EBV相关转录因子和免疫应答元件。利用我们的数据集和公共数据库，我们证明了BLLF3靶向的TLR2相关因子是DLBCL的有效诊断标志物。接下来，我们确认了LMP1靶向的钙通路因子在BL中的共表达。最后，我们证明了LMP1诱导的PARP1、HIF1A、HK2及关键糖酵解相关因子的相关性和共表达，进一步表明LMP1主动调控糖酵解通路。因此，我们的研究构建了EBV抗原与宿主信号通路在各种EBV相关疾病中相互作用的全面功能百科全书，为治疗策略的开发提供了宝贵见解。
